lines.en: Thou art from above?
lines.zh: 你是從上面來的？

lines.en: We were bidden let none pass below. Three hundred winters, and the order never lifted.
lines.zh: 我們奉命，不讓任何人往下走。三百年了，命令一直沒有撤。

lines.en: The gate is open now. Turn not back. See for me what lieth beneath.
lines.zh: 門既然開了，就別回頭。替我看看，底下到底是什麼。

lines.en: It promised me a heaven without walls.
lines.zh: 祂答應我，底下有一座沒有牆的天國。

lines.en: That was no god's voice. It was hunger.
lines.zh: 原來那不是祂的聲音，是祂的飢餓。

lines.en: Child, no guardian was ever a hero. We were offerings, every one.
lines.zh: 孩子，守門人從來不是英雄，是祭品。我們每一個都是。

lines.en: They would have more cores, more depth. I could but melt into the mountain and hold the ring.
lines.zh: 他們要熔核，要更多、更深。我只能把自己熔進山裡，撐住這一環。

lines.en: Thou bearest that heat as well. Beware: it is the same fire as the thing below.
lines.zh: 你身上也有熔核的熱。小心，那和底下的東西是同一團火。

lines.en: Thou hast grown. Thy grip is still too tight.
lines.zh: 長大了。劍還是握得太緊。

lines.en: I thought I could bear it alone. Every guardian thought so.
lines.zh: 我以為自己扛得住，一個人就夠了。每個守門人都這麼以為。

lines.en: Become not the next of me. Seal it no more. End it.
lines.zh: 不要成為下一個我。不要再封了，把它結束。

lines.en: It was I who sent her down. I swore I would stay beside her.
lines.zh: 是我送她下去的。我答應過，會一直陪著她。

lines.en: To keep that oath, I made myself this.
lines.zh: 為了守在這裡，我把自己變成這副模樣。

lines.en: Her name is Aislinn. When thou findest her, tell her I never left.
lines.zh: 她叫艾希琳。見到她的時候，告訴她，我一直沒有走。

lines.en: Thou thoughtest me master?
lines.zh: 你以為我是主宰？

lines.en: I am but a hand it reached forth. Cut a hand, and it groweth anew.
lines.zh: 我只是牠伸出來的一隻手。手斷了，還會再長。

lines.en: It lieth below. It hath watched thee all this while.
lines.zh: 牠在下面，一直看著你。

lines.en: This fire again… I have died once already.
lines.zh: 又是這團火……我已經死過一次了。

lines.en: This is not I. It learned my sword, but not my regret.
lines.zh: 這不是我。牠只學會了我的劍，沒學會我的後悔。

lines.en: It swallowed even my longing. Make haste; she lieth at the very bottom.
lines.zh: 牠連我的思念也吞了。快一點，她就在最底下。

lines.en: A hand grown anew is still but a hand.
lines.zh: 再長出來的手，也還只是一隻手。

lines.en: So long. I held it a thousand years. Thou needst not.
lines.zh: 好久了。我撐了一千年，你不必了。

lines.en: Thou didst not take my place. Thou didst end it.
lines.zh: 你沒有接替我。你把它結束了。

lines.en: She waiteth here for me. We shall go together.
lines.zh: 她也在這裡等我，我們一起走。

lines.en: Go home. The way above is given back to you.
lines.zh: 回去吧。上面的路，已經還給你們了。
